title: DelegationProfiles
description: The delegation profiles registry (registry/delegation-profiles.yaml): each profile owns the models a delegation may use and its tool scope. scripts/render_registry.py renders it into the profiles section of the model gateway's defaults.json.

modelKey.description: A model of the gateway's catalogue as `<client>:<model>`.

toolList.description: The names a profile allows of one kind of tool, or `any`. An empty list is deny-all.

models.description: The allowed models; the delegate picks the cheapest that covers the task.

pin.description: The one model of `models` the profile is held to.

ladder.description: Models of `models` a writer climbs through on escalation, cheapest first.

distinct_families.description: How many model families the allowed models must span once the data policy has cut them.

exclude_writer_family.description: The writer's family is left out; the request names it as narrow.writer_family.

tools.description: The tool scope. A kind left out is deny-all.

max_spend_usd.description: The most one run may spend; held by the gateway once #788 lands.
